scheme_name: Assistance On Death Of The Unregistered Worker (HBOCWWB)
other_conditions: Applicant must be a legal heir or dependent family member of an unregistered worker who died in a workplace accident.
Applicant must have a copy of the FIR related to the accident.
Applicant must have a post‑mortem report of the worker’s death.
Applicant must provide a certificate confirming they are the nominated/legal heir of the unregistered worker.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,50,000 is provided to the legal heir/dependent family member of an unregistered worker who dies in a workplace accident.
documents_required: Copy of the FIR related to the accident
Post‑mortem report of the worker’s death
Certificate confirming the applicant is the nominated/legal heir
